concepts.title: Area of a Trapezium
concepts.definition: The measure of planar region enclosed within a four-sided polygon possessing one pair of parallel opposing boundaries.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply the mean of the parallel lengths by the perpendicular separation.

concepts.title: Area of a General Quadrilateral
concepts.definition: The planar space bounded by an arbitrary quadrilateral evaluated by partitioning it along one diagonal into two distinct triangles.
concepts.key_idea: The total area equals half the main diagonal length times the sum of the perpendicular offsets from opposite vertices.
question_patterns: find the area of a quadrilateral given one diagonal and two offsets

solution_steps.explain: add the two heights dropped onto the common diagonal
multiply the diagonal length by the sum of offsets and divide by two

concepts.title: Area of a Rhombus
concepts.definition: The region covered by an equilateral quadrilateral computed using either its perpendicular diagonals or its base and altitude.
concepts.key_idea: Half the product of the lengths of mutually perpendicular diagonals.
question_patterns: find the area of a rhombus whose diagonals are given

solution_steps.explain: form the product of diagonal one and diagonal two
divide the diagonal product by two to obtain the enclosed area

concepts.title: Total Surface Area of a Cuboid
concepts.definition: The cumulative sum of the individual planar areas of all six rectangular bounding faces of a rectangular prism.
concepts.formula: total_area = 2 * (length * breadth + breadth * height + height * length)
concepts.key_idea: Twice the sum of pairwise products of the three orthogonal dimensions.

solution_steps.explain: find pairwise products of the three spatial dimensions

solution_steps.action: double the sum of face areas
solution_steps.explain: account for all three congruent pairs of faces

concepts.title: Lateral Surface Area of a Cuboid
concepts.definition: The total boundary area formed exclusively by the four vertical perimeter walls of a cuboid, excluding top and base.
concepts.key_idea: Perimeter of the rectangular base scaled by the vertical height.

concepts.title: Surface Area of a Cube
concepts.definition: The total area spanning the six identical square outer boundaries of a regular hexahedron.
concepts.key_idea: Six times the square of the edge length.

concepts.title: Surface Area of a Cylinder
concepts.definition: The combined boundary extent comprising the curved wall and the two identical circular flat bases of a right circular cylinder.
concepts.key_idea: Curved surface area is circumference times height; total adds two base circles.

concepts.title: Volume of a Cuboid
concepts.definition: The measure of three-dimensional space enclosed within the rectangular boundaries of a cuboid.
concepts.key_idea: Base area multiplied by the perpendicular height.

concepts.title: Volume of a Cube
concepts.definition: The three-dimensional capacity or space occupied by a regular hexahedron with all equal edges.
concepts.key_idea: The edge length raised to the third power.

concepts.title: Volume of a Cylinder
concepts.definition: The volumetric capacity enclosed by a right circular cylinder having parallel congruent circular faces.
concepts.key_idea: Area of the circular base cross-section multiplied by cylinder height.

concepts.title: Volume to Capacity Conversion
concepts.definition: The quantitative relationship translating cubic measures of solid volume into liquid capacity units like litres.
concepts.key_idea: One cubic metre corresponds precisely to one thousand litres, and one thousand cubic centimetres equal one litre.

questions: 1. The shape of the top surface of a table is a trapezium. Find its area if its parallel sides are 1 m and 1.2 m and perpendicular distance between them is 0.8 m.
